fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: What you call it, not what the bank calls it.

fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Current
Savings
Investment
Cash
Credit Card
Loan
fields.description: Credit Card is a liability: its balance is what you owe, it counts against the total rather than toward it, and the card shows how much of the limit is left.

fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.description: For a loan, enter what you owed on the opening date as a NEGATIVE number. A debt is money you do not have, and storing it negative means every total in the app subtracts it without a special case — a payment into the loan then moves it toward zero on its own.

fields.label: Target
fields.description: Optional. A savings goal, shown as a ring on the card.

fields.label: Credit Limit / Original Loan
fields.description: For a card, the limit. For a loan, the amount originally borrowed — it is what the progress bar measures against, so you can see how much has been paid off rather than only what is left.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: Last four digits or a note to recognise it by. Do not store a full account number.

fields.label: Money Here Funds Targets And Fixed Costs
fields.description: For an account that money arrives in on its way somewhere else — a salary account, a Wise balance. Its balance counts as money IN HAND against what you still need. It is not counted as raised: raised is money that has done its job, and this has not yet.
